query:
UPDATE crm_companies
               SET updated_at = now(),
                   first_interaction = CASE
                       WHEN $4 THEN LEAST(first_interaction, $2)
                       ELSE first_interaction
                   END,
                   last_interaction = GREATEST(last_interaction, $3)
               WHERE id = $1
                 AND (
                     last_interaction < $3
                     OR ($4 AND first_interaction > $2)
                 )
